pediatricPearls: Use pediatric dosing of medications or electrical therapy for a pediatric patient < 37 kg and as defined by HandTevy.
Fluids and Medication titrated to maintain a SBP >70 + (age in years x 2) mmHg

pl1: Evaluate for spinal motion restriction – Do not transport laying on long spine board
pl2: Adult: Isotonic Crystalloid IV bolus titrated to SBP ≥ 110; Pediatric 20 mL/kg as needed
pl3: Pain management – Fentanyl and/or Ketamine as indicated.
Blood Product Transfusion and Calcium Chloride to SBP ≥ 110 if hypotension due to hemorrhage
Norepinephrine to SBP ≥ 110 if no external hemorrhage or hemorrhage controlled
